description: This file defines the public APIs, data structures, macros, and constants for the 1-Wire driver in the Zephyr RTOS, including ROM commands, CRC calculations, and bus management functions.

methods.name: w1_read_rom
methods.description: Reads the 64-bit ROM code from a 1-Wire device.

methods.name: w1_match_rom
methods.description: Selects a specific 1-Wire slave device by its ROM.

methods.name: w1_resume_command
methods.description: Re-selects the last addressed slave with Match ROM or Search ROM.

methods.name: w1_skip_rom
methods.description: Addresses all slaves on the bus to receive a command.

methods.name: w1_reset_select
methods.description: Resets and selects a specific slave by ROM in single drop configurations.

methods.name: w1_write_read
methods.description: Writes data to and reads data from a slave with matching ROM.

methods.name: w1_search_bus
methods.description: Searches for slaves on the 1-Wire bus, optionally filtering by alarm.

methods.name: w1_search_rom
methods.description: Discovers unknown slaves by scanning for their ROM codes.

methods.name: w1_search_alarm
methods.description: Searches for slaves with active alarm conditions.

methods.name: w1_rom_to_uint64
methods.description: Converts a w1_rom struct to a uint64_t value.

methods.name: w1_uint64_to_rom
methods.description: Writes a uint64_t value into a w1_rom struct.

methods.name: w1_crc8
methods.description: Computes CRC-8 checksum for data validation.

methods.name: w1_crc16
methods.description: Computes CRC-16 checksum for data validation.
